statusNote: Proposed 2026-10-19 (Wind V2), renamed and boundary-corrected the same day under the specialist-Brain rule before any adoption. NOT pre-registered blind: the author knew the Oct 19 audit metrics when choosing weights. Weights, thresholds and evaluation logic are those of the never-adopted proposal `wind-bowfishing-intelligence-v2` (git c0ccf660), so the result is unchanged. Needs Michael's review; until then it is reported, labelled PROPOSED, and never replaces any score.
question: How well can Wind Brain, as the wind specialist, read the wind, assess which shorelines are exposed to or sheltered from it, estimate the wind-driven surface, track how both change over time, and state how reliable its wind assessments are? It does not score where to bowfish or fishing opportunity (Sector Intelligence's synthesis).

relationToOtherMeasurements.wind-certification-rubric-v1: Unchanged (3.3). Certification = proven on the water + operational maturity. Not replaced, not renumbered.
relationToOtherMeasurements.bwis-v1: Unchanged (5.4, frozen definition sha256 21e2a326...). V2 is a new version, not a re-score of v1.
relationToOtherMeasurements.movedOut: BWIS v1 B3 (paired-bank exposure truth, 7) and D2 (paired-bank decision truth, 10) are FIELD VALIDATION and move to Scientific Confidence; BWIS v1 E (operational integrity, 5) moves to Production Readiness. They are not deleted: both reports show them at 0 / partial.
relationToOtherMeasurements.movedIn: Wind-exposure ranking, wind-exposure alternatives, exposure/surface semantics, the hourly wind timeline, unknown handling and limitation honesty, each demonstrated by deterministic scenarios on the full frozen fetch tables of all four development lakes.

evidenceClasses.MEASURED_SKILL: Computed against real observations (METAR CAL+H1, NDBC buoys 2020-23) or exact geometry. H2 never read.
evidenceClasses.MODEL_CAPABILITY: Deterministic scenario pass/fail on real lake geometry with SYNTHETIC wind. Shows the behaviour exists and is coherent; says nothing about real-world accuracy.

rules: credit is linear between `zero` and `full` (clamped); an item with several conditions takes the minimum;
an unmeasured item or a missing input earns 0 (unknown is never passed);
a MODEL_CAPABILITY item earns its share of (lake x mapped scenario) passes over ALL four development lakes; a missing lake counts as failed;
exploratory methods (e.g. the probabilistic strong-wind flag) earn nothing until validated on a clean holdout;
no caps: field validation is not part of this measurement (Scientific Confidence reports it); the score is never shown without the certification score and the Scientific Confidence status beside it.

weightRationale.windInterpretation: 25: every wind assessment is downstream of the wind; strong-wind events are where the forecast fails and matter most for exposure, so event detection carries 10.
weightRationale.windExposureGeometry: 20: telling wind-exposed from wind-sheltered shorelines is Wind's core specialist output.
weightRationale.windExposureAssessment: 20: the ranked exposure assessment, its explanations and the wind-exposure alternatives are what Sector Intelligence consumes; forecast-vs-observed surface-class agreement shows whether the assessment holds under real forecast error.
weightRationale.windDrivenSurface: 15: surface magnitude matters, but class boundaries are coarse and partly carried by the assessment items.
weightRationale.windTemporalBehaviour: 12: conditions change over hours; transient realism is a known weakness.
weightRationale.uncertaintyManagement: 8: cheap to provide, and protects consumers from false certainty.

items.label: Strong-wind event detection (deterministic, night >= 15 mph, every lead)
items.scale: min over leads of POD credit (0 -> 0, 0.5 -> full) x min over leads of FAR credit (0.8 -> 0, 0.5 -> full; no forecast events -> full); 0 observed events -> 0

items.label: Fetch geometry QA (hashes, 9-ray method, exact-geometry <= 5%, 50 national lakes)
Wind-exposed vs wind-sheltered ordering on real geometry (S01, S02, S06)
Wave height vs lake buoys (Hm0 MAE, 2020-23 holdout)
Surface class vs lake buoys (exact, within 1, severe miss)
items.scale: min(exact 0.20 -> 0.60, within1 0.50 -> 0.90, severe 0.25 -> 0.05) (BWIS v1 C2 curves)

items.label: Coherent wind-driven surface semantics (calm/strong, class bounds, exposure vs surface, monotonic) (S03, S10, S17)
Surface-class forecast agreement: forecast wind vs observed wind give the same wind-driven surface class (night, symmetric >= 5 mph)
items.note: symmetric selection per the BWIS v1 D1 definition note (v1's observed-only selection favours high-biased forecasts)

items.label: Deterministic, explained, contract-valid wind-exposure ranking (S16, S18)
Wind-exposure alternatives: less-exposed and nearest wind-sheltered banks (S11)
Hourly wind timeline: direction shift flips exposed shores, easing reported (S04, S14)
Transient realism (wave memory) vs frozen M0
items.scale: 6 if a memory model passed its pre-registered promotion rule; 0 with M0 (BWIS v1 C3 logic)

items.label: Never fabricate: missing geometry, unknown wind, stale forecast, unsupported lake (S07, S08, S09, S15)
Confidence and limitations: lead time, strong-wind regime, no HIGH without field truth (S12, S13)

supersedesProposal.why: Wind is a specialist Brain: the score measures WIND capability, not bowfishing recommendations, which Sector Intelligence owns. Renamed categories and items; no weight, threshold, criterion or evidence change.

specialistBoundary: No item reads fish, water-clarity, lake-habitat or combined opportunity evidence; every item is a wind-domain calculation, forecast skill, or wind-assessment behaviour.
